title.narrative: Frexus: Improving security and climate resilience in a fragile context through the Water-Energy-Food Security Nexus

description.narrative: Project aims at developing and testing of an assessment tool/methodology regarding the linkages between resources use, climate change and conflicts as well as identification and implementation of activities to counter the challenges found especially in fragile contexts.It pursues an integrated and Nexus-based approach that will be applied to counter negative spirals of resource scarcity and conflict and, instead, establish climate resilient development opportunities.
